Riya: quick follow-up from all-hands — leadership wants two one-liners we can share with customers: Console traffic controls (UI + API) and Optimize recommendations (batching + quantization). Can product provide?

Sam (Product): Console traffic controls: private beta mid-May (2026-05-18), public beta late June (week of 2026-06-22). Caveat: depends on quota backend migration; possible 1 week slip.

Diego (Runtime): Quota migration staging status: 5/6 services migrated. Flag: staging rollback would add ~1 week delay.

Sam (Product): Optimize recommendations: internal alpha early May, public beta mid-July; hosted-only at launch, Dedicated support planned in August (Q3) after smoke validation. Recs include confidence score + safety flag if eval harness detects regressions.

Maya (DevEx): I'll draft a short FAQ + SDK snippets by Monday. Example snippet for route limits: POST /v1/console/route-limits {"route_id":"checkout","limit_per_min":1200}.

Liam (Sales): I'll hold outbound briefings until FAQ is published. If docs land Mon/Tue I can brief accounts Wed.

Riya: perfect — Sam, please add these to the roadmap and tag owners so I can share with customers.

Sam (Product): done, added roadmap entries and tagged @Maya and @Diego; will update if migration slips.

Riya: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
